questions.question: In Daniel's vision, a goat shattered the two horns of a ram. What did the goat then do to the ram?

answers.text: Threw him down and trampled him
Chased him across the Ulai Canal
Let another ram come to rescue him

questions.question: In Daniel's vision of a ram and a goat, who was told to explain the vision to Daniel?
After Daniel saw the ram and the goat, what did Gabriel say the vision concerns?
Gabriel told Daniel an insolent king would stand against the Prince of princes. How would this king's rule end?

answers.text: He would be broken off but not by human hands
He would be defeated by a great human army
He would keep ruling until his old age
